content:
Marta: Noticed duplicate fragments when we do a midstream model swap. Clients sometimes get the same chunk twice or a cut mid-token.
AJ: Is that during graceful preempt or a hard kill?
Marta: Graceful swap. We attempt a handoff but the edge replays fragments.
Sam: Are there multiple upstream requests?
Marta: No, @deploy-bot shows a single upstream call. The duplication looks internal.
Neel: Can you paste the log sample?
Marta: snippet: 
```
FRAME seq=777 payload=\"...and then we\"
FRAME seq=777 payload=\"...and then we\"
```
Marta: identical seq repeated.
Sam: Sounds like a race: preempt happens before checkpoint persisted, so resume replays same seq.
Neel: Two short-term options: block preempt until a soft checkpoint flushes (adds tail latency), or emit tombstone resume tokens on preempt so duplicates <= tombstone are dropped.
AJ: Tombstone is attractive but only safe for read-only streams. For tool-calls we must avoid dropping duplicates unless callers guarantee idempotency.
Marta: Proposal: route-level flag `resume.supports_side_effects=false` (default false). Tombstone resume allowed when false.
Neel: Config sketch: ingress.preempt=graceful, resume.enabled=true, resume.tombstone_window=64, resume.supports_side_effects=false.
Sam: Add metrics: `edge.resume.tombstones`, `edge.resume.duplicates_dropped`, `edge.resume.replay_attempts`.
AJ: Also ensure we only bind upstream `X-Resume-Token` trailer after frag ack loop completes to avoid token/seq mismatch.
Marta: I'll prototype tombstone + route flag and add a regression that injects midstream preempt.
Sam: I'll write the RFC and tests.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: ingress/edge-v3 at 2026-03-22T02:00Z. :robot_face:
Marta: Will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
